title: Home · 3D printing
description: The Bambu Lab X2D through Bambuddy, what printing costs, and how dry the filament is.

panels.title: Done at
panels.description: Wall-clock time the current print should finish.

panels.title: Queue
panels.description: Jobs waiting in Bambuddy's print queue.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.integration_id == "tuya" and r._field == "raw_19" and r.name == "3D printer")
  |> last()

panels.title: Plug cost this month

targets.query:
import "timezone"
import "date"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Helsinki")
energy = from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1mo), stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.integration_id == "tuya" and r._field == "raw_19")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) / 10.0, device: r.name}))
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
price = from(bucket: "nordpool")
  |> range(start: date.truncate(t: now(), unit: 1mo), stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "price" and r._field == "price")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])
join(tables: {e: energy, p: price}, on: ["_time"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, device: r.device, _value: r._value_e / 1000.0 * r._value_p / 100.0}))
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device == "3D printer")
  |> group() |> sum()

panels.description: The printer's smart-plug energy at the hourly spot price.

panels.title: Prints per week

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', coalesce(started_at, created_at)) AS time, status AS metric, count(*) AS value
FROM print_archives WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(started_at, created_at))
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Bambuddy's print archive, back to the first print.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT date_trunc('week', coalesce(started_at, created_at)) AS time, coalesce(filament_type, 'Unknown') AS metric,
       sum(filament_used_grams) AS value
FROM print_archives WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(coalesce(started_at, created_at))
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

targets.query:
import "timezone"
option location = timezone.location(name: "Europe/Helsinki")
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r.integration_id == "tuya" and r._field == "raw_19")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.name == "3D printer")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value) / 10.0, device: r.name}))
  |> group(columns: ["device"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1h, fn: mean, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1d, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))

targets.rawSql:
SELECT coalesce(started_at, created_at) AS "Started", print_name AS "Print", status AS "Result",
       print_time_seconds AS "Duration", filament_used_grams AS "Filament", filament_type AS "Material",
       cost AS "Cost", failure_reason AS "Why it failed"
FROM print_archives WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY coalesce(started_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 25

SELECT print_name AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM print_archives
WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'completed' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Filament cost

targets.rawSql:
SELECT sum(cost) AS "Total", coalesce(sum(cost) FILTER (WHERE started_at > date_trunc('month', now())), 0) AS "This month",
       avg(cost) FILTER (WHERE status = 'completed') AS "Per print"
FROM print_archives WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

panels.description: Bambuddy's filament cost per print, from the spool prices.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY print_time_seconds) AS "Duration",
       percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY filament_used_grams) AS "Filament"
FROM print_archives WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND status = 'completed'

panels.title: Printer runtime

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(print_hours_offset + runtime_seconds / 3600.0) * 3600 AS runtime FROM printers

panels.description: Total print-head hours as Bambuddy counts them for maintenance.

panels.title: Maintenance

targets.rawSql:
WITH p AS (SELECT id, print_hours_offset + runtime_seconds / 3600.0 AS hours FROM printers)
SELECT t.name AS "Task", coalesce(pm.custom_interval_hours, t.default_interval_hours) AS "Every (h)",
       round((p.hours - pm.last_performed_hours)::numeric, 1) AS "Since (h)",
       round((coalesce(pm.custom_interval_hours, t.default_interval_hours) - (p.hours - pm.last_performed_hours))::numeric, 1) AS "Due in (h)",
       pm.last_performed_at AS "Last done"
FROM printer_maintenance pm JOIN maintenance_types t ON t.id = pm.maintenance_type_id JOIN p ON p.id = pm.printer_id
WHERE pm.enabled AND NOT t.is_deleted AND coalesce(pm.custom_interval_type, t.interval_type) = 'hours'
ORDER BY 4

panels.description: Hour-based maintenance from Bambuddy. Negative means overdue; mark it done in Bambuddy.

panels.title: Spools

targets.rawSql:
SELECT material AS "Material", coalesce(nullif(color_name, ''), '#' || left(rgba, 6)) AS "Colour", brand AS "Brand",
       greatest(label_weight - coalesce(weight_used, 0), 0) AS "Left", label_weight AS "Of", last_used AS "Last used"
FROM spool WHERE archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY 4

panels.description: Spool inventory as Bambuddy tracks it; weights are only as good as its usage tracking.

panels.title: Humidity now

targets.query:
import "dict"
names = ["CE2A83062A34": "Filament dryer", "C76A00462055": "AMS 1", "C76A05065C4E": "AMS 2", "CE2A82463295": "Drybox 1", "D9343130222A": "Drybox 2", "CE2A8486490B": "Drybox 3"]
from(bucket: "home")
  |> range(start: -6h, stop: now())
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "hum")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.device_id == "CE2A83062A34" or r.device_id == "C76A00462055" or r.device_id == "C76A05065C4E" or r.device_id == "CE2A82463295" or r.device_id == "D9343130222A" or r.device_id == "CE2A8486490B")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: r._value), place: dict.get(dict: names, key: r.device_id, default: r.device_id)}))
  |> group(columns: ["place"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

  |> last()
